# Hakone Ginyu (箱根吟遊)

> > Luxury spa resort ryokan in Hakone featuring private open-air onsen baths, seasonal kaiseki cuisine, and award-winning GinyuSpa treatments amidst mountain forest views.

Hakone Ginyu is a premium Japanese ryokan located in the Hakone mountains overlooking Hayakawa Valley. The resort specializes in authentic Japanese hospitality with all guest rooms featuring private open-air hot spring baths, multi-course kaiseki dining, and exclusive spa amenities from their original GinyuSpa and GinyuShop product lines.

## Key Topics

- Hakone Ginyu (箱根吟遊)
- Private open-air onsen baths
- Luxury ryokan experience
- Kaiseki cuisine
- GinyuSpa treatments
- Hakone mountains (箱根連山)
- Japanese hospitality
- Hayakawa Valley (早川渓谷)
- GinyuShop original products
- Spa resort amenities
- Japanese-Western fusion rooms
- Natural hot springs
- Teppan-yaki dining
- Wellness retreats

## Guest Rooms with Private Onsen

- [Kaze-Type Rooms (風タイプ)](https://www.hakoneginyu.co.jp/guestroom_kaze.html): Kaze-type rooms with open-air onsen, Hakone mountain views
- [Tsuki-Type Rooms (月タイプ)](https://www.hakoneginyu.co.jp/guestroom_tsuki.html): Tsuki-type rooms with private onsen, Japanese/Western style
- [Sora-Type Rooms (空タイプ)](https://www.hakoneginyu.co.jp/guestroom_sora.html): Sora-type rooms with private onsen, in-room dining available
- [Hoshi-Type Rooms (星タイプ)](https://www.hakoneginyu.co.jp/guestroom_hoshi.html): Hoshi-type rooms: Japanese/Western/maisonette with private onsen

## Onsen & Spa Facilities

- [Onsen Quality & Benefits](https://www.hakoneginyu.co.jp/onsen.html): Onsen quality & benefits: natural spring, infinity bath, healing waters
- [GinyuSpa Treatments](https://www.hakoneginyu.co.jp/spa.html): GinyuSpa treatments: TOP 10 Japan spa, wellness in Hakone forest
- [Facility Guide](https://www.hakoneginyu.co.jp/facility.html): Facility guide: spa, dining halls, lounge bar, hot spring baths

## Dining & Cuisine

- [Seasonal Kaiseki Cuisine](https://www.hakoneginyu.co.jp/cuisine.html): Seasonal kaiseki cuisine with teppan-yaki & room service dining
